PublicFlavorCard.Name: Public hazard turn card
PublicFlavorCard.Hint: Also post a short public card when a hazard takes its turn.

SkipDisabledTurns.Name: Skip disabled hazards
SkipDisabledTurns.Hint: Automatically advance past a disabled hazard's turn.

RemoveDisabled.Name: Remove disabled hazards from combat
RemoveDisabled.Hint: Remove a hazard's combatant once every component is disabled.

Debug.Name: Debug logging
Debug.Hint: Log Hazarder decisions (e.g. why an action was or was not counted) to the browser console.

EnforceProficiency.Name: Enforce proficiency requirements
EnforceProficiency.Hint: Disable options marked e.g. "(master)" can only be attempted by characters with at least that rank in the skill. Under-ranked rolls are blocked from the tracker and not counted from chat.

Tracker.Title: {name}: Disable
Tracker.NoDisables: No disable options — edit the plan
Tracker.RankTooLow: {actor} needs {rank} proficiency for {skill}; the check does not count.

Turn.Title: {name}'s turn
Turn.SaveForTargets: Post this save for your targets (one action per target)
Turn.SaveForTargetsAction: Post this save for your targets

Plan.Title: Hazard plan: {name}
Plan.Review: {name} has no confirmed plan. Review it now?
Plan.Label: Label
Plan.SharedSuccessesHint: Blank = each option counts on its own. A number makes every option add to one shared total, and the per-option counts are ignored.

Warnings.actions-per-turn-missing: Could not find "(N actions)" in the routine.
Warnings.no-disables: No inline checks found in the disable text.
Warnings.successes-heuristic: Successes needed guessed from wording — please verify.
Warnings.shared-successes: Disable text says "any combination" — options share one success total. Please verify.
Warnings.component-count-unknown: Found a named component but not how many — set the count.
Warnings.parse-error: The parser failed; fill the plan in by hand.

Triggered.Title: {name} triggered!
Triggered.Body: A critical failure triggered the hazard. Post its reaction?
Triggered.NoReaction: A critical failure triggered the hazard. It has no reaction to post.
